methods.bayes: Bayesian linear trend on yearly means (Jeffreys prior, Student-t posterior); Bayes factor from BIC.
methods.extremes: Quantile regression of deseasonalised monthly values at the 10th, 50th and 90th percentiles; standard errors widened for month-to-month autocorrelation (AR(1) effective sample size).
methods.emergence: LOWESS signal relative to the 2000-2009 level, divided by year-to-year noise; emerged when |S/N| > 1 to the end of the record.
methods.years_needed: Record length at which the current slope would reach p < 0.05 given the current noise.
methods.hazards: Extreme month = beyond that calendar month's 2000-2011 90th (heat, flood) or 10th (drought, topsoil) percentile; fire weather = top-quarter heat and bottom-quarter humidity together. Frequency trend by quasi-binomial GLM; Benjamini-Hochberg across all sites and hazards. "Now" = fitted chance for a month in 2024.
methods.dry_spells: Two-state Markov chain on dry (below the baseline monthly median) and wet months; likelihood-ratio test of P(dry to dry), 2000-2011 vs 2012-2024.
methods.aridity: UN aridity index = rain / Thornthwaite potential evaporation; classes from UNEP. Sen slope, Mann-Kendall p.
methods.stability: Warming, rain change, temperature swings, rain swings and extra extreme months, each ranked against all sites; mean percentile = score (100 = most stable); 200 block-bootstrap resamples of years give the 95% range.
